title: Why Would You Avoid White Rice for Dinner?
description: A fun Indian style story where Aarav discovers why eating too much white rice at night might not be the best idea, with Grandma’s wisdom and some humor.

scenes.description: wide shot of Aarav sitting at the dinner table staring at a big bowl of white rice
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide shot:1.2) 9-year-old Indian boy Aarav with short hair, wearing bright T-shirt and shorts, sitting at wooden dining table with steel thali and bowls, staring at fluffy white rice in steel bowl, evening light, storybook style:1.3
scenes.negative_prompt: blurry, dark, low resolution, scary, distorted, extra limbs
scenes.narration: Why do people often say—don’t eat too much rice at night? Well, Aarav was about to find out the funny reason. He sat at the table, eyes fixed on the fluffy bowl of white rice, as if it was calling his name.
scenes.subtitle: The Dinner Dilemma
scenes.motion_prompt: boy staring curiously at bowl of rice

scenes.description: close-up of white rice looking fluffy and shiny, almost talking to Aarav
scenes.visual_prompt: (close-up:1.2) fluffy steaming white rice in steel bowl, glowing slightly, storybook style:1.3
scenes.narration: The steaming rice almost looked alive. Aarav imagined it whispering, ‘Come here, my boy! I’m warm, fluffy, and delicious. Don’t just stop at one plate—have two, maybe three!’
scenes.subtitle: The Tempting Rice
scenes.motion_prompt: rice steaming, looking magical and playful

scenes.description: medium shot of Grandma entering with a wise smile, pointing at the rice
scenes.visual_prompt: (medium shot:1.2) 70-year-old Indian grandma with white hair tied in bun, wearing light cotton saree with border, smiling wisely, pointing at steaming rice bowl, storybook style:1.3
scenes.narration: Just then, Grandma walked in with her wise smile. She wagged her finger and said, ‘Aarav, if you eat too much rice at night, you will surely fall asleep quickly… but your poor tummy will shout—Oh no, what have you done!’
scenes.subtitle: Grandma’s Warning

scenes.description: funny shot of Aarav imagining himself bloated after eating too much rice
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide shot:1.2) 9-year-old Indian boy Aarav, short hair:1.1, wearing T-shirt:1.1 and shorts:1.1, cartoon style imagination:1.15, big round tummy:1.15, funny expression:1.1, storybook style:1.3
scenes.negative_prompt: blurry, dark, distorted, extra limbs, creepy
scenes.narration: Aarav giggled and imagined himself after eating three bowls of rice. In his mind, his tummy puffed up like a giant balloon, and he waddled around like a walking golgappa. What a silly thought—it made him laugh even louder!
scenes.subtitle: The Funny Imagination

scenes.description: wide shot of Aarav eating just a small portion of rice with veggies and smiling
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide shot:1.2) 9-year-old Indian boy Aarav, short hair:1.1, wearing T-shirt:1.1 and shorts:1.1, eating from steel thali:1.2, small portion white rice:1.15, sabzi:1.1, dal:1.1, smiling:1.1, 70-year-old Indian grandma in cotton saree:1.2 sitting beside, storybook style:1.3
scenes.narration: Finally, Aarav made a smart choice. He took just a little bit of rice, added sabzi and dal, and mixed it all up in his steel thali. One bite and he smiled—mmm, tasty, filling, and so much healthier too!
scenes.subtitle: The Smart Choice

scenes.description: Aarav waving goodnight with Grandma, rice bowl in background looking sad
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide shot:1.2) Indian boy age 9, short hair, cotton pajamas, waving hand, grandma age 70, cotton saree, smiling, steel rice bowl cartoon sad eyes, storybook style
scenes.narration: That night, Aarav went to bed with a happy tummy and a big smile. The rice bowl looked a little sad in the background, but Grandma patted Aarav’s head and said, ‘See, less rice at night means sweet dreams and more energy tomorrow!’ So kids, remember—less rice, more dreams. scenes.subtitle: The Bedtime Secret
